status: pre-registered 18 Nov 2026: D1, D6, D23 and the scoring rule confirmed by the user; later changes go to deviations.json
score_from_rule: per person and direction, each pre-registered comparison is scored on the samples both of its arms predict: from max(score_from_s, the later first prediction of the two arms after the trial start); the descriptive scores and the val-test agreement (D2b) score every final arm on one shared start: max(score_from_s, the latest first prediction of any final arm)

fine.units: same or one step either side
fine.batch: same or one step either side (windows only)
fine.bounds: every value stays inside the coarse space

gates.reference: one comparison: against the shorter full-overlap length whose best R1 config has the best score (mean over people of log validation nMAE on D24 common targets)

R1.name: coarse
R1.configs: the 6 shared random draws + the anchor

R2.name: fine
R2.configs: fine draws around the best R1 config of the cell

F2.averaged_over: window lengths that ran all rounds

val_test_agreement: descriptive (D2b): per person, Spearman rho between session-1 validation nMAE and session-2 nMAE over the cell winners; changes no choice
one_se_scope: cell winners only (R3); A0 is the cell winner with the best score on the D24 common targets
a0_rule: best score (mean over people of log validation nMAE on D24 common targets) among the cell winners; no 1-SE rule
limitations: No shuffling (D27): with stride-1 windows in time order a batch of 64 is 0.64 s of one trial, while at 0 % overlap a batch spans 64 distinct windows; the overlap family (F2) therefore also measures batch diversity, and an overlap effect may partly be a shuffling effect.
Fixed, untuned training settings: ReduceLROnPlateau 0.5/6, early-stopping patience 15, clipnorm 1.0, dropout at most 0.3, no weight decay.
The lagged ridge baseline (A1) sees 0.5 s of lags, while the networks get up to 10 s of history: a reference, not an equal competitor.
The decision rule (all 6 people agree in sign and median effect >= 5 %) is conservative, so 'no clear difference' is the expected outcome for small effects.

budget.gated_rule: only the 2 s window is screened (R1 at full overlap, D23 gate); a length that passes is reported as 'not tuned (budget)': its other cells are not run within this study, and 5 s and 10 s are not screened
budget.checks: after 24 h of R1, and again when R1 ends (before R2 specs are written)

fallback_text.drop_o75: drop the 3 cells at 75 % overlap (their R1 runs are queued last, so few or none have run)
fallback_text.fine_2: fine round 4 -> 2 draws per cell (the first 2 of the same 4)

budget.rule: EXPERIMENTS/tuning/budget.py projects the total wall time from measured run times only (seedN.json prep_s + train_s; never a score), with the plan's run multipliers for cells not yet measured, the worst measured cell for A0 and A3, and 6 workers; it adds the fallback steps in order until the projection is within 'days'; steps are only added, never removed; if every step is applied and it is still over, the study stops for the user's decision. The result is results_v2/budget.json, committed by scripts/run_study_v2.sh budget.
